create_rectanguloid_shape: create a solid rectanguloid shape with specified width, height, and depth dimensions
create_hollow_rectanguloid_shape: create a hollow rectanguloid shape with configurable wall thickness and optional corner-only frame
create_sphere_shape: create a solid sphere or spherical shell with a given radius and optional thickness
create_square_pyramid_shape: create a square pyramid shape with configurable slope, radius, and height parameters
arrange_shapes_in_circle_or_line: arrange schematic shapes in a circle or line pattern with configurable count and spacing
